nodes.label: TSMC
nodes.relation: Makes and packages every NVIDIA data center GPU; publishes revenue monthly
nodes.summary: TSMC's monthly revenue is the earliest hard read on how many AI chips are coming off the line for NVIDIA.
brief: Its monthly sales show NVIDIA's chip output months before NVIDIA books the revenue.
nodes.health: October sales hit a 2026 high of NT$586.9B, up 59.7% on last year.
nodes.tracks: Wafer and packaging output that becomes NVIDIA data center revenue
nodes.reading: NT$586.89B in October 2026, up 14.7% from September and 59.7% from October 2025; Jan-Oct up 43.3%
nodes.cadence: Monthly, about 10 days after month end
nodes.leads: About one to two quarters ahead of NVIDIA's reported data center revenue

nodes.label: Foxconn (Hon Hai)
nodes.relation: Largest assembler of NVIDIA rack-scale AI systems
nodes.summary: Foxconn's cloud and networking segment is the biggest single read on NVIDIA racks leaving the factory.
brief: Its cloud segment tracks NVIDIA rack shipments almost in real time.
nodes.health: October revenue was a record NT$1.3 trillion, up 45.73% year on year.
nodes.tracks: Shipments of NVIDIA GB300 and Vera Rubin racks
nodes.reading: NT$1.3 trillion in October 2026, up 12.66% from September and 45.73% from a year earlier; cloud and networking dipped slightly from September
nodes.cadence: Monthly, about 5 days after month end
nodes.leads: Roughly coincident with NVIDIA's quarter, but readable about a month before NVIDIA reports

nodes.label: Quanta Computer
nodes.relation: Builds NVIDIA AI server racks for the hyperscalers
nodes.summary: Quanta's monthly sales and its rack-count commentary show both the volume and the pricing of NVIDIA systems.
brief: Its sales and rack counts split NVIDIA growth into volume versus price.
nodes.health: October revenue NT$353.25B, up 104% year on year; Jan-Oct up 99.9%.
nodes.tracks: NVIDIA rack shipments to US cloud customers, in units and dollars
nodes.reading: NT$353.25B in October 2026, up 8.6% from September and 104.0% from October 2025
nodes.cadence: Monthly, about 10 days after month end
nodes.leads: About one month ahead of NVIDIA's report for the same quarter

nodes.label: Wistron
nodes.relation: Makes NVIDIA GPU baseboards and AI servers
nodes.summary: Wistron builds the GPU boards that go into NVIDIA systems, so its sales sit close to NVIDIA's own shipments.
brief: Its board sales move almost one for one with NVIDIA GPU shipments.
nodes.health: October revenue NT$402.6B, up 117.6% year on year; Jan-Oct up 99.5%.
nodes.tracks: NVIDIA GPU baseboard and AI server volumes
nodes.reading: NT$402.62B in October 2026, up 5.7% from September and 117.6% from October 2025
nodes.cadence: Monthly, about 6 days after month end
nodes.leads: About one month ahead of NVIDIA's report for the same quarter

nodes.label: Wiwynn
nodes.relation: Builds hyperscalers' own server designs, including custom-chip racks
nodes.summary: Wiwynn's sales track hyperscaler AI server spending in general, including racks built around their own chips.
brief: Shows whether cloud AI spending is still rising, NVIDIA or custom chips.
nodes.health: October revenue NT$165.1B, up 80.9% year on year but down 4.3% on September.
nodes.tracks: Hyperscaler AI server spending, both NVIDIA-based and custom-chip
nodes.reading: NT$165.13B in October 2026, down 4.3% from September and up 80.9% from October 2025
nodes.cadence: Monthly, about 6 days after month end
nodes.leads: About one month ahead; a looser read on NVIDIA because some racks use custom chips

nodes.label: Hyperscaler capex
nodes.relation: The budgets that pay for most NVIDIA data center revenue
nodes.summary: Quarterly capex at Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta funds the hyperscale half of NVIDIA's data center sales.
brief: Hyperscalers bought $60.1B of NVIDIA's $107.6B data center revenue last quarter.
nodes.health: Alphabet spent $51.4B and Microsoft $45.2B on capex in the September quarter.
nodes.tracks: Cash the four largest US clouds spend on data centers each quarter
nodes.reading: September quarter 2026: Alphabet $51.4B, Microsoft $45.2B, Meta $34.91B; 2026 guides of $195-205B (Alphabet), $135-145B (Meta), about $220B (Amazon)
nodes.cadence: Quarterly, with each company's earnings in late October, January, April and July
nodes.leads: About one quarter ahead of NVIDIA's data center revenue

nodes.label: TrendForce
nodes.relation: Industry tracker of AI server shipments and cloud capex
nodes.summary: TrendForce's AI server and cloud capex forecasts set the industry-wide size of next year's NVIDIA opportunity.
brief: Its 2027 forecasts size the market NVIDIA's data center revenue grows into.
nodes.health: Sees nine leading clouds spending over $1.5 trillion on capex in 2027.
nodes.tracks: AI server shipments and revenue, and capex at the nine largest cloud companies
nodes.reading: October 14, 2026: CSP capex $957B in 2026 (up 106%), over $1.5T in 2027 (up 60%); AI server revenue up over 90% to nearly $920B in 2027
nodes.leads: Two to four quarters ahead of reported revenue

nodes.label: Ornn Compute Price Index
nodes.relation: Tracks what NVIDIA GPUs rent for in the neocloud market
nodes.summary: Rising GPU rents mean buyers still cannot get enough compute, which keeps new NVIDIA orders coming.
brief: Rising rents mean compute is scarce, which pulls through more NVIDIA orders.
nodes.health: B200 rent near $9.84 per GPU-hour in mid-November, up 32% in a month.
nodes.tracks: Spot rental prices for NVIDIA GPUs, a real-time gauge of demand against supply
nodes.reading: Mid-November 2026: B200 $9.84 per GPU-hour (up 32% in a month), H200 $7.75 (up 49%), H100 $3.25 (up 8.3%)
nodes.leads: One to two quarters ahead; rising rents push GPU clouds to order more systems

nodes.label: Street consensus
nodes.relation: Analyst expectations NVIDIA's data center revenue is judged against
nodes.summary: Consensus sets the bar each reading has to clear; NVIDIA has beaten it by a wide margin.
brief: Data center revenue beat the $101.24B consensus by about $6.4B last quarter.
nodes.health: January-quarter revenue consensus was $124.8B before NVIDIA guided $130B.
nodes.tracks: What analysts expect NVIDIA's data center and total revenue to be
nodes.reading: Q3 FY27 data center consensus $101.24B (Zacks, Nov 13) vs $107.6B actual; Q4 FY27 revenue consensus $124.8B (Nov 16) vs $130B guide
nodes.cadence: Continuously updated; snapshot before each report
nodes.leads: Sets the bar for the next report on February results day

signals.headline: NVIDIA's data center revenue hit $107.6B in the October quarter, up 110% from a year ago
signals.whyItMatters: This is the KPI itself: data center revenue was $107.6B in the quarter ended October 25, up 110% from a year ago and 21% from the prior quarter, though growth eased from 117% in the July quarter.
signals.evidence: Data Center: Third-quarter revenue was $107.6 billion, up 21% from the previous quarter and up 110% from a year ago.

signals.headline: Can AI Infrastructure Demand Sustain NVIDIA's Q3 Data Center Growth?
signals.whyItMatters: Analysts expected $101.24B of data center revenue and NVIDIA reported $107.6B, a beat of about 6%, so the street was still too low going into the quarter.
signals.evidence: The Zacks Consensus Estimate for third-quarter data center revenues is pegged at $101.24 billion

signals.headline: Earnings Watch | NVIDIA Q3 FY27
signals.whyItMatters: The street had $124.8B of total revenue pencilled in for the January quarter and NVIDIA guided $130B, so next quarter's estimates have to move up.
signals.evidence: Consensus revenue for the January quarter (Q4 FY27) is $124.8 billion.

signals.headline: NVIDIA Q3 Earnings Beat on Data Center Demand & Rubin Ramp-Up
signals.whyItMatters: Part of the $130B guide is calendar, not demand: the January quarter has an extra week, and receivables days rose to 64 from 60 on longer payment terms for some customers.
signals.evidence: The outlook includes an additional week and assumes no Data Center compute revenues from China.

signals.headline: TSMC October 2026 Revenue Report
signals.whyItMatters: TSMC's record October means more NVIDIA chips are being made and packaged, which shows up in NVIDIA's data center revenue over the next one to two quarters.
signals.evidence: revenue for October 2026 was approximately NT$586.89 billion, an increase of 14.7 percent from September 2026

signals.headline: Hon Hai's revenue hits record NT$1.3 trillion in October
signals.whyItMatters: Total sales hit a record, but the cloud segment that carries NVIDIA racks slipped from September on supply limits, so the first month of NVIDIA's January quarter was not a straight line up.
signals.evidence: recorded a slight decline from September despite continued strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI) applications

signals.headline: Quanta (2382) October consolidated revenue NT$353.25 billion, up 104.0% year on year
signals.whyItMatters: Quanta's sales doubled from a year ago and rose 8.6% from September, which points to NVIDIA rack shipments still climbing at the start of NVIDIA's January quarter.
signals.evidence: 10 月合併營收 3,532.50 億元，較上（9）月成長 8.6%，與去年同期相比為年增 104.0%

signals.headline: Quanta (2382): fewer AI racks shipped, revenue still grows as average price takes over
signals.whyItMatters: Quanta shipped slightly fewer AI racks in the September quarter and expects fewer again in December, so growth is coming from higher prices per rack rather than more units, a weaker base if pricing stalls.
signals.evidence: 公司預期第 4 季方向相同：出貨總櫃數比第 3 季略減，營收繼續季增。

signals.headline: Wistron (3231) October revenue NT$402.6 billion, up 117.6% year on year
signals.whyItMatters: Wistron makes NVIDIA's GPU baseboards, so sales more than doubling and rising 5.7% from September point to steady GPU volumes into NVIDIA's January quarter.
signals.evidence: 10 月營收，達 4,026.15 億元，較 9 月成長 5.7%，較去年同期成長 117.6%

signals.headline: Wiwynn (6669) October revenue NT$165.13 billion, up 80.9% year on year
signals.whyItMatters: Hyperscaler server builds are still up 80.9% on last year, but sales fell 4.3% from September, and part of this spending goes to racks built on the clouds' own chips instead of NVIDIA's.
signals.evidence: 10 月營收，達 1,651.32 億元，較 9 月成長 -4.3%，較去年同期成長 80.9%

signals.headline: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results: search and cloud grow, free cash flow is negative
signals.whyItMatters: Alphabet spent $51.4B in the quarter and says 2027 capex will rise significantly, which funds next year's hyperscale data center orders, though some of it builds TPU systems that compete with NVIDIA.
signals.evidence: $51.4 billion in capital expenditures, or CapEx

signals.headline: Microsoft's stock rises on solid earnings and revenue beat, with Azure growing 48%
signals.whyItMatters: Microsoft spent $45.2B against estimates as high as $50.67B because some third-party capacity arrived late, a reminder that data center build delays can push NVIDIA shipments out a quarter.
signals.evidence: Microsoft spent $45.2 billion on capital expenditures and finance leases, up by around 30% from a year before.

signals.headline: CSP CapEx Projected to Exceed US$1.5 Trillion in 2027, with AI Server Revenue Growing Over 90% YoY on Higher Shipments and Prices, Says TrendForce
signals.whyItMatters: If the nine largest clouds lift capex 60% to over $1.5 trillion and AI server revenue grows over 90% in 2027, NVIDIA's data center revenue has room to keep growing next year.
signals.evidence: In 2027, this figure is expected to surpass $1.5 trillion, representing a further 60% YoY increase.

signals.headline: Ornn Exchange data shows GPU rental prices climbing month-on-month across chip generations
signals.whyItMatters: Blackwell rents up 32% and H200 rents up 49% in a month mean GPU clouds can earn more per chip, which is what makes them place the next NVIDIA order.
signals.evidence: the B200, part of Nvidia's Blackwell line, was renting for approximately $9.84 per GPU-hour. That reading was up 32% from the preceding month.
